evidence.observation: Reboiler temperature reads 411.707 °C, markedly separated from the other column temperatures.

T701 has risen to 418.299 °C while the other listed temperatures remain between 44.354 and 61.333 °C; this isolated high reading requires verification and does not by itself identify thermocouple drift.
System pressure is 199.327 mbar with differential pressures of 0.269 and 1.859 mbar; system pressure has remained near 200 mbar despite the T701 rise.

args.missing_evidence: Independent reboiler temperature measurement, T701 calibration and scaling checks, and protocol temperature limits are needed to distinguish actual overheating from a sensor/readout fault. No composition measurement is available to assess separation.
